objective: Repeat the bounded continuous public microstructure qualification with a tested provider-response alias contract while preserving the failed first attempt unchanged.
provenance_rule: Every accepted record must preserve the raw provider channel and payload hash while also recording the normalized logical channel; l2_data is the only added alias supported by the failed-attempt diagnostic.
pass_gate: At least one logical level2 snapshot and update, one market-trades message, and one heartbeat are durably captured; raw l2_data provenance remains visible; per-logical-channel gaps/out-of-order/duplicates are explicit; replay, restart, corruption, bounds, quality, and zero-effect gates pass.
failure_gate: Any first-attempt artifact is rewritten, alias provenance is lost, a required channel is missing, replay diverges, integrity/restart fails, bounds are exceeded, or authentication/account/order/signer/wallet/capital access occurs.
scope_limit: Public spread/depth distribution evidence only; no fee tier, order latency, rejection, partial-fill, actual-fill, economic-edge, capital, or live qualification.
